data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-year reserve release of $177.6m in 2015 (compared with $149.6m in 2014), reflecting favourable claims development overall and particularly strong releases in the reinsurance and specialty lines divisions. This improvement contributed to a lower claims ratio and an improved combined ratio for the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount taken from Managing Agent narrative/strategic report which states 'release prior year reserves of $177.6m' and shows divisional releases; no separate 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross movement line was present. Amount treated as gross (not net). LOB mapping to standard Lloyd's categories required judgement: 'Political risks & contingency' mapped to 'Casualty' and 'Specialty lines' mapped to 'Professional Lines'; 'Reinsurance' mapped to 'Treaty'. Claims development triangle present but not in a full cumulative-by-development-period format suitable for diagonal PYD extraction, so PYD sourced from narrative release figure.
